faqs: Are the treatments safe for my dogs and cats?
Many specialists offer pet-safe solutions. You can filter for these professionals and discuss the specific chemicals via chat before booking.
Do I need to leave my house during the treatment?
This depends on the specific pest and treatment method. Your verified professional will advise you on safety protocols via the app before they arrive.
What if the pests return after a week?
You can negotiate warranty periods within the app. Furthermore, your payment remains in escrow for a designated period to ensure the treatment was effective.
